title: ranunculus heldreichii
intro: Ranunculus heldreichii, commonly known as the Heldreich's buttercup, is a species of flowering plant in the family Ranunculaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, including its ability to promote relaxation and reduce inflammation, which can contribute to improved sleep quality and relief from arthritic pain. The bioactive constituents of Ranunculus heldreichii include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The health benefits of Ranunculus heldreichii include its potential to improve cardiovascular health, boost the immune system, and exhibit anticancer properties.
